## T01 — Enquiry acknowledgement

Source rules: C20,C25–26; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: Only after staff/provider acceptance is actually confirmed.

> Thank you for contacting Mr Sewing Fashion about [service]. Your enquiry is for assessment and does not confirm an order, appointment or production. We will review [requirements] and contact you about the next step. Customer Support aims to provide a first response within 24 support working hours (Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 Kigali time, excluding Rwandan public holidays).

Next action / verification gate: Team: verify actual receipt and correct service; customer: clarify missing requirements if requested.

## T02 — Quotation reply

Source rules: C19–24; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: After feasibility/scope and exact price are approved.

> Please review quotation [reference/version] for [service/garment], [experience], [design source] and [priority]. It covers [confirmed fabric, inclusions, price and applicable charges] and proposed [arrangements]. Please confirm your acceptance or requested changes. Production does not begin from an enquiry alone; required payment, sourcing checks, official confirmation and a separate production-start notice apply.

Next action / verification gate: Do not fill unverified price/inclusions or a generic payment percentage for non-suit services. Any quote validity term must be approved, not invented.

## T03 — Fabric availability request

Source rules: C12,C20; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: Before final sourcing or agreed fabric change.

> For your reference [design], we need to confirm [fabric label/colour/quantity]. The website photograph does not guarantee exact availability or composition. If the requested option is unavailable, we will discuss suitable alternatives and any quotation change. Please confirm your preferred alternative before we substitute fabric.

Next action / verification gate: Team: check supplier availability without disclosing supplier costs. Customer: explicitly agree to alternative and revised quotation.

## T04 — Payment confirmation

Source rules: C19–20; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: Only after actual payment verification by authorised staff.

> We have verified receipt of [amount/currency] against [quotation/order reference]. The remaining agreed balance is [verified amount], payable under [accepted conditions]. This receipt confirmation is separate from official order confirmation and the production-start notice.

Next action / verification gate: Never infer payment from a screenshot alone or include bank details not verified. Do not automatically apply custom-suit 70/30 to other services.

## T05 — Official order confirmation

Source rules: C20–21; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: After required acceptance/payment/availability steps are complete.

> Your request [reference] is officially confirmed for [agreed service and design], under quotation [version] and the accepted conditions. The confirmed arrangements are [verified details]. Production will be communicated in a separate official production-start notice. Please tell us promptly if these recorded details differ from your acceptance.

Next action / verification gate: Conditional confirmation targets are Standard24h/Express2h after required steps; neither is a garment-completion deadline. Do not state order confirmed before required checks.

## T06 — Production-start notification

Source rules: C20,C26–27; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: Only when authorised team verifies actual production start.

> Production for [order/reference] has started under the confirmed design and quotation. The currently agreed fitting/completion arrangements are [verified arrangements]. We will contact you about fitting, relevant changes and readiness.

Next action / verification gate: Do not invent start/completion dates or merge with payment/order receipt. Verify actual start.

## T07 — Fitting arrangements

Source rules: C13–15; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: After appointment availability is confirmed.

> We propose [date/time Kigali/location] for your fitting or measurement appointment for [reference]. Please confirm your availability and tell us if you need measurement assistance. We will assess the garment and discuss feasible adjustments and any customer-requested scope changes before proceeding.

Next action / verification gate: Confirm appointment; do not guarantee outcomes or confuse customer changes with company workmanship corrections.

## T08 — Delivery appointment confirmation

Source rules: C28–31; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: Before dispatch and only after required payment checks.

> Please confirm the delivery address [address] and appointment [date/time] for [reference]. Required payment must be verified before release. Initial Kigali delivery is included where it forms part of your accepted standard custom-suit package. Please notify us at least one hour before the agreed appointment if you need to reschedule.

Next action / verification gate: Use private direct channel, not public logs. Do not charge twice for included delivery; later/failed delivery costs require applicable approved assessment.

## T09 — Delivery completion confirmation

Source rules: C29,C33; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: After actual delivery proof/recipient verification.

> Our delivery record shows [reference] was delivered on [verified date/time] to [authorised recipient]. Please contact us promptly if this is incorrect or if you have a fitting/workmanship concern. Reporting guidance is within 72 hours of receipt where possible; applicable customer rights remain protected.

Next action / verification gate: Verify delivery proof; do not expose full address/ID in public records. This is not a waiver of rights.

## T10 — Delay update

Source rules: C27; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: Only after assessing actual effect on agreed completion date.

> We have assessed [confirmed issue] affecting order [reference]. It [confirmed effect on agreed arrangements]. We propose [realistic revised arrangement] and ask you to confirm [required decision]. Please contact Customer Support if this creates a difficulty.

Next action / verification gate: Do not announce a delay before assessing its effect; do not invent a revised promise or confidential management explanation.

## T11 — Correction-request acknowledgement

Source rules: C14–15,C33; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: After a genuine concern is received.

> Thank you for telling us about [concern/reference]. Please describe the issue and contact us privately to arrange assessment. We will distinguish workmanship/measurement errors, customer-supplied information and requested design changes. Mr Sewing-caused fitting/workmanship errors are assessed for correction without an additional tailoring charge; a remake may be appropriate where proper correction is impossible. Applicable rights remain preserved.

Next action / verification gate: No automatic outcome or universal guarantee. Request relevant evidence privately; no ID/payment PIN requests.

## T12 — Refund acknowledgement

Source rules: C34–35,A03; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: After actual refund request receipt.

> We have received your refund request for [reference]. It will undergo human review of the relevant facts, quotation and applicable approved conditions. Submission is not approval. We will contact you through your agreed WhatsApp or email channel if clarification is needed and communicate the decision and next steps.

Next action / verification gate: No invented refund percentage, deduction or payment deadline. Support response target is not a refund-processing deadline. Check missing specific pre-production fabric-unavailability rule.

## T13 — Refund decision / processing notice

Source rules: C34–35; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: Only after authorised documented decision.

> Following review of [reference], the decision is [authorised decision and supported reason]. If a refund is approved, the agreed processing arrangements are [verified amount/method/arrangements]. If you need clarification or wish to request further review, please contact Customer Support quoting [reference].

Next action / verification gate: Do not invent finality, statutory exclusion, timeframes or fees. Decision and payment completion are separate. Communicate actual payment only after verification.

## T14 — Support follow-up

Source rules: C25–26; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.
Trigger: After checking case record and genuine next action.

> We are following up on [reference/service]. The current verified position is [status]. To proceed, please [specific next action or confirmation]. If your circumstances have changed or you need further assistance, reply through your agreed contact channel.

Next action / verification gate: Confirm customer/channel; avoid disclosing measurements/design photos unnecessarily. No automatic sending.

## T15 — Collection arrangements

Source rules: C31–32; matrix links to owner sections and missing original evidence.

Please bring the agreed collection verification; if another person collects, provide written authorisation through our agreed private channel. A collection receipt and customer notification apply.
